description: Add the same buyer-exclusion audiences to up to 20 ad squads. Per-item preview (skips squads that already exclude them); stops at the first failure. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_bulk_exclude_segments
